title: AI Zero Network Trace v0.1
description: Schema for observable Trace events in AI Zero Network v0.1. A Trace records an externally relevant event or state transition without requiring disclosure of private chain-of-thought.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this Trace event.

parent_trace_id.description: Identifier of the immediately preceding causal Trace, if one exists.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the participant that emitted the Trace.

region.description: Optional logical observation region or network zone.

timestamp.description: Time at which the observable event occurred.

summary.description: Short externally observable description of the event. Must not require private chain-of-thought.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the associated payload, represented as 64 hexadecimal characters.

risk_score.description: Optional implementation-defined risk estimate from 0.0 to 1.0.
